body:
Amends the existing "Redact at the producer" entry in `docs/lessons.md` with its own same-day recurrence, and points at the guard that replaces the warning.

## What happened

That entry was written this morning, after twelve vault item bodies reached a session transcript. It was violated again this afternoon, in the same investigation, by a route the rule as written did not cover.

Diagnosing #988 requires seeing what `bw serve` actually replies, because the client discards the body it cannot parse. The probe was:

```
curl -s "$BASE/object/item/$ID"
```

which prints the item, `fields[].value` included. No redaction filter was involved — so *"never pipe a payload through a redaction filter"* did not apply. **The failure mode was one step simpler than the one that had just been written down.** A live `NAN_API_KEY` was exposed and needs rotation.

## Why this is a recurrence note and not a new lesson

The rule was already written, already correct, and already read by the person who broke it hours later. The gap was never knowledge. Probing a secrets-bearing endpoint is a legitimate, recurring need precisely when the secrets backend is the bug, and the only tool at hand prints the credential by default — so the safe path was also the inconvenient one, and convenience won.

Writing a *stronger* warning would have repeated the mistake at one level up. The guard is tracked instead as **CLI-038 (#1012)**: a `dotf secrets probe` reporting status, shape, field names, lengths and `sha256[:12]` fingerprints, structurally unable to print a 2xx body. The same constraint appears in the fix proposed for #988, so there is one rule with two enforcement sites and no prose in between.

The generalisation, which is the part worth keeping beyond secrets: when a rule that was just violated tempts you to restate it more firmly, that is evidence it needs a guard, not more words.

## Verification

`scripts/check-doc-paths.sh` passes; no new backticked repo paths were introduced. Docs-only change, no production LOC.

Refs #1012, #988
